text: the paucity of studies on alternative modalities makes it difficult to draw firm conclusions on this variable. Importantly, muscular gains are limited to the early phases after initiating a regimented aerobic exercise program. Results plateau in a relatively short time, and evidence suggests that persistent aerobic training can actually have a detrimental impact on Type II fiber hypertrophy.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 6: Role of Aerobic Training in Hypertrophy
